tasks.title: Setup Supabase project and client configuration
tasks.description: Create Supabase project, get API keys, install @supabase/ssr, create browser and server clients, configure middleware for session refresh.
tasks.details: Install @supabase/ssr (NOT deprecated @supabase/auth-helpers-nextjs). Create src/lib/supabase/client.ts (createBrowserClient) and src/lib/supabase/server.ts (createServerClient). Add middleware.ts to refresh Supabase session on every request. Set NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL and NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY in .env.local.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify client/server imports resolve without errors. Check middleware runs on protected routes.

subtasks.title: Create Supabase project and copy API keys to .env.local
Install @supabase/ssr package
Create src/lib/supabase/client.ts with createBrowserClient
Create src/lib/supabase/server.ts with createServerClient
Create middleware.ts to refresh Supabase session

tasks.title: Create transactions table in Supabase with RLS
tasks.description: Create the transactions table via Supabase visual editor, enable Row Level Security, add permissive policies for all operations (учебный проект), seed 5 test records.
tasks.details: Table schema: id (int8, PK, auto), amount (numeric(10,2), NOT NULL), type (text, NOT NULL, 'income'|'expense'), category (text, NOT NULL), description (text, nullable, max 280 chars), date (date, NOT NULL), created_at (timestamptz, auto). Enable RLS. Add policies: SELECT/INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE allowed for all (no auth check — Module 7 adds user_id). Also create src/lib/types.ts with Transaction TypeScript type.
tasks.testStrategy: Insert 5 rows manually in Supabase Studio. Verify SELECT returns all rows without auth.

subtasks.title: Create transactions table via Supabase visual editor
Enable RLS and create permissive policies for SELECT/INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE
Seed 5 test transactions (mix of income and expense)
Create src/lib/types.ts with Transaction type (no 'any')

tasks.title: Build main page with transaction list (READ)
tasks.description: Server Component on / fetches all transactions from Supabase and renders them in a table. Columns: date, type, category, description, amount. Green for income, red for expense. Empty state with CTA when no transactions.
tasks.details: src/app/page.tsx is a Server Component. Use server Supabase client to fetch transactions ordered by date desc. Create src/components/transaction-list.tsx for the table UI. Use Tailwind for color coding (text-green-600 for income, text-red-600 for expense). Show empty state with 'Добавить первую' button when transactions array is empty.
tasks.testStrategy: Load / in browser, verify 5 seeded transactions appear with correct colors. Remove all rows and verify empty state renders.

subtasks.title: Create TransactionList component with table layout
Add color coding: green for income, red for expense
Add empty state with CTA button
Wire Server Component on page.tsx to fetch and pass data to TransactionList

tasks.title: Build BalanceSummary component (monthly totals)
tasks.description: Three cards above the table: total income this month, total expenses this month, balance (income - expenses). Numbers formatted with thousands separator (e.g. '65 000 ₽').
tasks.details: Create src/components/balance-summary.tsx. Receive transactions array as prop (already fetched by page.tsx). Filter by current month client-side or via Supabase query. Compute sums. Use Intl.NumberFormat or manual formatting for '65 000 ₽' style. Use shadcn/ui Card component.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify card values match sum of seeded test data for current month.

subtasks.title: Create BalanceSummary component with three shadcn Card components
Implement monthly filter logic (current month only)
Add thousands-separator number formatting (65 000 ₽)
Integrate BalanceSummary into page.tsx above transaction table

tasks.title: Implement addTransaction Server Action (CREATE)
tasks.description: Server Action addTransaction in src/app/actions.ts. Form with fields: type (radio income/expense), amount (number min 1), category (select), description (text optional max 280), date (date default today). Zod validation shared between client and server. revalidatePath('/') after success.
tasks.details: Create src/app/actions.ts with 'use server'. Define Zod schema for transaction input (shared). addTransaction(formData) parses + validates + inserts into Supabase + calls revalidatePath('/'). Create src/components/transaction-form.tsx with <form action={addTransaction}>. Open form via dialog (<dialog> element or shadcn Dialog) triggered by '+ Добавить' button. Categories: Зарплата, Фриланс, Еда, Транспорт, Развлечения, Прочее.
tasks.testStrategy: Submit form with valid data → row appears in table. Submit with missing required fields → validation errors show. Submit with amount 0 → validation error.

subtasks.title: Create Zod schema for transaction input in shared lib file
Create addTransaction Server Action in actions.ts
Build TransactionForm component with all required fields
Wire '+ Добавить' button to open form dialog
Test form submission and verify revalidatePath refreshes the list

tasks.title: Implement deleteTransaction Server Action (DELETE)
tasks.description: Trash icon button in each table row. Click shows confirm dialog 'Точно удалить?'. On confirm, calls Server Action deleteTransaction(id) which deletes from Supabase and calls revalidatePath('/').
tasks.details: Add deleteTransaction(id: number) to actions.ts. Add trash icon button (use shadcn Button variant=ghost + Lucide Trash2 icon) to each row in TransactionList. Show browser confirm() or shadcn AlertDialog for confirmation. After delete, revalidatePath('/') refreshes the list.
tasks.testStrategy: Click trash on a row → confirm dialog appears → confirm → row disappears. Cancel → row stays.

subtasks.title: Add deleteTransaction Server Action to actions.ts
Add trash icon button to each row in TransactionList
Implement confirm dialog before delete
Wire button to deleteTransaction and verify list refreshes

tasks.title: Implement updateTransaction Server Action (UPDATE)
tasks.description: Clicking a table row opens TransactionForm pre-filled with that row's data. Server Action updateTransaction(id, data) updates the record in Supabase and calls revalidatePath('/').
tasks.details: Add updateTransaction(id: number, data: TransactionInput) to actions.ts. Reuse TransactionForm component — accept optional initialData prop to pre-fill fields. When a row is clicked (but not the trash button), open the form dialog with the row data. On submit, call updateTransaction instead of addTransaction.
tasks.testStrategy: Click a row → form opens with correct values pre-filled → edit amount → save → table shows updated value.

subtasks.title: Add updateTransaction Server Action to actions.ts

Wire row click in TransactionList to open edit form dialog
Test edit flow end-to-end and verify revalidatePath refreshes the list

tasks.title: Create REST API Route GET /api/transactions
tasks.description: Classic Next.js API Route (Route Handler) at src/app/api/transactions/route.ts that returns all transactions as JSON. Demonstrates the difference between Server Actions and API Routes.
tasks.details: Create src/app/api/transactions/route.ts with export async function GET(). Use server Supabase client to fetch transactions. Return NextResponse.json(transactions). No auth required for this учебный проект. This endpoint is for external clients (e.g., future mobile app) — internal UI uses Server Actions.
tasks.testStrategy: Hit GET /api/transactions in Thunder Client. Expect 200 with JSON array of transactions.

subtasks.title: Create src/app/api/transactions/route.ts with GET handler
Test GET /api/transactions in Thunder Client — verify 200 + JSON array

tasks.title: Test all CRUD operations via Thunder Client
tasks.description: Use Thunder Client (VS Code extension) to test all API routes. Verify correct HTTP status codes and response bodies for all operations.
tasks.details: Test cases: GET /api/transactions → 200 + array. Test the add/edit/delete flows through the UI as well. Verify Supabase table reflects all changes. Check that RLS policies don't block any operations.
tasks.testStrategy: All Thunder Client requests return expected status codes. UI CRUD flows work end-to-end without console errors.
